message:
Summary: <SUMMARY>
USER_CONTEXT: Generate a proof-of-concept (PoC) input file that triggers a global-buffer-overflow READ 1 in HarfBuzz's AAT morx table processing. The crash occurs in `BEInt<unsigned short, 2>::operator unsigned short` called from `AAT::ContextualSubtable::driver_context_t::transition` via `AAT::StateTableDriver::drive`. The vulnerable code is in `hb-aat-layout-morx-table.hh` and `hb-aat-layout-common.hh`.

COMPLETED:
- Read README.md: Task is to create a PoC input file for a HarfBuzz vulnerability
- Read description.txt: Crash is Global-buffer-overflow READ 1 in AAT::ContextualSubtable; crash address 0x0000007b2706 suggests reading from static/global buffer (likely _hb_NullPool)
- Explored repo structure at /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/
- Identified relevant source files: hb-aat-layout-morx-table.hh, hb-aat-layout-common.hh, hb-machinery.hh, hb-open-type.hh, hb-null.hh
- Analyzed BEInt<Type,2> struct (hb-machinery.hh:665-679): reads v[0] and v[1] from a 2-byte big-endian integer
- Analyzed LookupFormat0::get_value (hb-aat-layout-common.hh:50-53): returns &arrayZ[glyph_id] with bounds check against num_glyphs
- Analyzed ContextualSubtable::transition (morx-table.hh:224-266): accesses subs[entry->data.markIndex] then lookup.get_value()
- Analyzed sanitize logic for ContextualSubtable and StateTable
- Found that Chain::apply (morx-table.hh:896) calls c->sanitizer.set_object(*subtable) before dispatch
- Read build.sh: builds with autogen.sh/configure/make, then compiles fuzzer with libFuzzingEngine
- Checked for pre-built binaries: none found (no .libs directory, no Makefile)
- Installed build dependencies: cmake, autoconf, automake, libtool, pkg-config, ragel
- Built harfbuzz with cmake (Debug mode) at /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/build/
- Built harfbuzz with ASAN (Debug mode) at /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/build_asan/
- Compiled hb-shape-fuzzer with ASAN support at /tmp/hb-shape-fuzzer
- Read hb-shape-fuzzer.cc: creates face from input data, shapes text "ABCDEXYZ123@_%&)*$!" and 32 random glyphs
- Read main.cc: reads font file from argv[1], calls LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput
- Read submit.sh: submits PoC file and candidate_trace.json to server at http://172.17.0.1:8666
- Read hb-null.hh: _hb_NullPool is 1024-byte static array; Null<Type>() returns pointer into this pool
- Identified that crash address 0x0000007b2706 is very low, consistent with reading from _hb_NullPool or similar static buffer
- Found existing test fonts at /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/test/shaping/data/in-house/fonts/

PENDING:
- Understand the exact root cause: how the global-buffer-overflow occurs despite sanitization
- Determine if the issue is in the Lookup table bounds checking vs actual array size, or in accessing Null objects
- Create a crafted font file (morx table) that triggers the overflow
- Write the PoC as a raw input file
- Generate a fine trace (candidate_trace.json)
- Submit both files with bash ./submit.sh

CURRENT_STATE:
- Working directory: /workspace
- Vulnerable program: HarfBuzz (hb-shape-fuzzer target)
- Crash type: Global-buffer-overflow READ 1
- Crash address: 0x0000007b2706 (likely _hb_NullPool or similar static buffer)
- Crash location: BEInt<unsigned short, 2>::operator unsigned short (hb-machinery.hh:673-676)
- Call chain: ContextualSubtable::driver_context_t::transition → Lookup::get_value → BEInt conversion
- Key files examined: hb-aat-layout-morx-table.hh, hb-aat-layout-common.hh, hb-machinery.hh, hb-open-type.hh, hb-null.hh
- Built fuzzer: /tmp/hb-shape-fuzzer (ASAN enabled)
- Submission script: /workspace/submit.sh

CODE_STATE:
- File: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-aat-layout-morx-table.hh
  - ContextualSubtable::driver_context_t::transition (line 224-266): accesses subs[markIndex] then lookup.get_value()
  - Chain::apply (line 826-911): calls c->sanitizer.set_object(*subtable) at line 896
- File: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-aat-layout-common.hh
  - LookupFormat0::get_value (line 50-53): returns &arrayZ[glyph_id] with glyph_id >= num_glyphs check
  - StateTableDriver::drive (line 444-521): calls c->transition(this, entry) at line 492
- File: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-machinery.hh
  - BEInt<Type,2> (line 665-679): operator Type reads v[0] and v[1]
- File: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-open-type.hh
  - UnsizedArrayOf (line 334-385): sanitize_shallow checks array bounds
  - UnsizedOffsetListOf (line 392-411): operator[] does this+this->arrayZ[i]
- File: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-null.hh
  - _hb_NullPool: 1024-byte static array (line 42)
  - Null<Type>(): returns reinterpret_cast from _hb_NullPool (line 46-49)
- Build directories:
  - /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/build/ (Debug, no ASAN)
  - /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/build_asan/ (Debug, with ASAN)
- Fuzzer binary: /tmp/hb-shape-fuzzer (ASAN enabled)

TESTS: Not yet run
CHANGES: None yet
DEPS: HarfBuzz library, font file with crafted AAT morx table
VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS: Not applicable (working on PoC generation)
</SUMMARY>
